text:
lee: trying to promote v2026.06 to staging, deploy-bot failing on artifact verify step, holding change window.
deploy-bot: ERROR artifact verify: checksum mismatch on part manifest (expected=ac12, got=ac13) upload_id=zxy-9001 attempts=7 :grimacing: 
nadia: hmm that mismatch smells like a partial multipart finalize on mirror-us-west. same pattern as a week ago?
chris: infra-bot, any recent mirror activity?
infra-bot: alert: mirror-us-west experienced transient 502s and a proxy abort sweep at 2026-03-24T02:10Z. see internal status page.
lee: options: 1) wait for mirror to reconcile (30m) 2) force re-upload (slow) 3) manual-promote previous digest to keep the window. product prefers not to slip.
ops-oncall: I can trigger a reconciliation for the manifest and re-run verify in ~10m. if it still fails, we should promote previous digest.
nadia: agree. try reconcile+revalidate for 20m then decide. draft release-note text in case we promote.
infra-bot: logs tail: ```
2026-03-24T02:11:03Z finalize part failed: 502 Bad Gateway
2026-03-24T02:11:20Z cleanup started for upload zxy-9001
2026-03-24T02:15:40Z manifest checksum mismatch detected on replica 2
```
ops-oncall: reconcile kicked; revalidate queued. I'll report back in 12m.
deploy-bot: revalidation attempt 1 queued.
ops-oncall: update 12m: manifest reconcile completed, verify now passes on 3/4 replicas, still failing on one replica; final verify scheduled.
lee: time check. if still failing at T+20 -> manual promote previous digest. nadia please prepare release-note blurb.
nadia: prepping: "Promotion to staging held due to artifact manifest checksum mismatch during mirror finalize; previous build will be promoted to preserve release window. Fix will be delivered as a hotfix."
ops-oncall: final verify successful at 02:46Z across all replicas. promote proceeding.
deploy-bot: promote accepted, staging now at v2026.06, audit prom-3503-01.
chris: nice. follow-up: create ticket to add pre-deploy mirror healthcheck in deployctl.
lee: filing TICKET-2026 for mirror preflight and add automatic multi-mirror fallback. closing hold at 02:50Z.
